bracket_games_scores_check.name: bracket_games_scores_check
bracket_games_scores_check.value: ("bracket_games"."side_a_score" is null or "bracket_games"."side_a_score" >= 0) and ("bracket_games"."side_b_score" is null or "bracket_games"."side_b_score" >= 0)

player_enrollments_school_check.name: player_enrollments_school_check
player_enrollments_school_check.value: ("player_enrollments"."school_id" is not null or "player_enrollments"."school_name" is not null)

recruitment_events_one_live_offer_per_sc.name: recruitment_events_one_live_offer_per_school
recruitment_events_one_live_offer_per_sc.where: "recruitment_events"."type" = 'offered' and "recruitment_events"."voided_at" is null and "recruitment_events"."school_id" is not null

recruitment_events_one_live_offer_per_sc.name: recruitment_events_one_live_offer_per_school_name
recruitment_events_one_live_offer_per_sc.where: "recruitment_events"."type" = 'offered' and "recruitment_events"."voided_at" is null and "recruitment_events"."school_id" is null

recruitment_events_school_check.name: recruitment_events_school_check
recruitment_events_school_check.value: ("recruitment_events"."type" in ('offered', 'committed', 'decommitted', 'signed', 'enrolled')) = ("recruitment_events"."school_id" is not null or "recruitment_events"."school_name" is not null)

recruitments_destination_check.name: recruitments_destination_check
recruitments_destination_check.value: "recruitments"."status" not in ('committed', 'signed', 'enrolled') or ("recruitments"."destination_school_id" is not null or "recruitments"."destination_school_name" is not null)

recruitments_transfer_origin_check.name: recruitments_transfer_origin_check
recruitments_transfer_origin_check.value: "recruitments"."kind" <> 'transfer' or ("recruitments"."origin_school_id" is not null or "recruitments"."origin_school_name" is not null)
